name: Taspinar E-Invoicing for XRechnung & ZUGFeRD
author: nuhtaspinar

sections.description:
German businesses must issue electronic invoices for B2B transactions from 2027/2028. This plugin
generates a compliant e-invoice automatically whenever an order reaches a configurable status —
inside your own shop, with no cloud service involved.

Features

  • XRechnung (CII, EN 16931) and ZUGFeRD PDF/A-3 generated from any order
  • Automatic generation on status change (for example “Processing”)
  • Gap-free invoice number series, renewed each year, protected against duplicate assignment
  • Correct tax handling (19 %, 7 %, 0 %, small-business rule § 19 UStG)
  • Shipping costs as their own line item
  • Leitweg-ID field in the checkout for public-sector buyers (B2G)
  • PDF and XML attached to the order e-mail and available in the customer account
  • Credit notes (type 381) on refunds, referencing the original invoice
  • Archive of every generated file in a protected upload directory
  • Compatible with HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)

Legal note: The generated files follow EN 16931 and the XRechnung rules (KoSIT 3.0.2).
Values taken from the order are proposals — please check every invoice before sending it.

External services

This plugin does not use any external services. Every invoice is created locally inside your
installation; no data is transmitted to third parties.
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate the plugin.
  2. Open WooCommerce → E-Rechnung.
  3. Enter your company address, VAT ID or tax number, and a contact person.
  4. Choose your invoice number series — done.
sections.faq:
Do I need a server or a cloud service?

No. All files are created inside your own WordPress installation.

Does it work with HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)?

Yes.

What happens on a cancellation?

On a refund a credit note (type 381) is created automatically, referencing the original invoice.
The original invoice stays unchanged, so the number series remains gap-free.

Which invoice formats are supported?

XRechnung as CII XML (EN 16931) and ZUGFeRD PDF/A-3 with the XML embedded. Both are produced for
every order; the PDF is the human-readable rendering of the same data.

Are the generated invoices validated?

The plugin ships its own rule checks (EN 16931 and the XRechnung business rules). The invoices used
in our tests were additionally validated with the official KoSIT validator (XRechnung 3.0.2).
sections.changelog:
1.1.6

  • Renamed plugin to “Taspinar E-Invoicing for XRechnung & ZUGFeRD” (no third-party trademark in the name).
  • Unified 8-character prefix taspinv_ for options, transients, order meta and admin actions.
  • License clarified as GPL-2.0-or-later, contributor nuhtaspinar added.

1.1.5

  • Neu: Firmenlogo aus der Mediathek auf der Rechnung (PDF), Einstellung „Logo (Anhang-ID)“.

1.1.4

  • Uninstall function renamed to the full plugin prefix

1.1.3

  • Constants and the autoload variable use the full plugin prefix (Plugin Check: PrefixAllGlobals)

1.1.2

  • Uninstall routine moved into a function (no global variables) — final Plugin Check warning removed

1.1.1

  • Text domain aligned with the plugin slug (taspinar-e-invoicing) — fixes TextDomainMismatch
  • Plugin Check warnings documented (nonce handled by WooCommerce checkout, GET_LOCK is a lock primitive)

1.1.0

  • Fix: number assignment now also works without MySQL (SQLite or restricted environments) — a failed GET_LOCK blocked invoice generation
  • Fix: credit notes take their amounts from the original order when the refund carries no line totals
  • Fix: credit note lines now use the internal data format (amounts used to be 0.00)
  • Tested with a real WordPress 7.1 + WooCommerce installation; invoice and credit note validated with KoSIT

1.0.0

  • Credit notes (type 381) on refunds, referencing the original invoice
  • Leitweg-ID field in the checkout (B2G)
  • Separate number series for invoices and credit notes

0.9.0

  • First release: XRechnung + ZUGFeRD from orders, number series, e-mail attachment, Leitweg-ID
